slices.focus: Ariana falls into the social world of marching-band competitions as a stress refuge
slices.summary: Ariana attends a marching-band competition with Devon and becomes fascinated by the parent gossip, director rivalries, and lineup politics. She develops a genuine interest in local band culture over pro sports, keeping it as a light seasonal side interest.
